explanation:
- **✅:green[True]**: Los Notebooks en Google Cloud incluyen funciones mágicas que permiten ejecutar consultas de BigQuery directamente desde el cuaderno, facilitando la integración de análisis de datos y la ejecución de consultas SQL sin salir del entorno del notebook.
- **:red[False]**: Esta opción es incorrecta; efectivamente, los Notebooks soportan funciones mágicas para interactuar con BigQuery.

question: Select the statement that does not apply to Notebooks.
answers: Notebook instances are standard Compute Engine instances that live in your projects
It's up to you to install the latest ML libraries on the notebooks
You can easily change hardware including adding and removing GPUs
They use the latest open-source version of JupyterLab
correct_answer: It's up to you to install the latest ML libraries on the notebooks
explanation:
- **:green[✅It's up to you to install the latest ML libraries on the notebooks]**: Esto es incorrecto; Google Cloud Notebooks generalmente vienen preconfigurados con las últimas bibliotecas de ML populares, por lo que no necesitas instalarlas manualmente.

- **:red[Notebook instances are standard Compute Engine instances that live in your projects]**: Esto es cierto; las instancias de Notebooks son instancias de Compute Engine que existen dentro de tus proyectos en Google Cloud, permitiendo control y configuración directa.

- **:red[You can easily change hardware including adding and removing GPUs]**: Es correcto, las configuraciones de hardware pueden ser modificadas fácilmente, lo que incluye la opción de añadir o eliminar GPUs según las necesidades de procesamiento.

- **:red[They use the latest open-source version of JupyterLab]**: Es correcto; los Notebooks de Google Cloud utilizan la última versión de código abierto de JupyterLab, lo que facilita un entorno actualizado y eficiente para el desarrollo y la ejecución de código.

question: Which technology was developed as a solution to run Kubernetes clusters and pods behind the scenes to support deploying pipelines?
answers: Cloud Composer
Cloud Orchestrator
Kubeflow
Vertex Pipelines
correct_answer: Vertex Pipelines
explanation:
- **✅:green[Vertex Pipelines]**: Fue desarrollado para gestionar la ejecución de pipelines de machine learning de forma transparente sobre clusters de Kubernetes, facilitando la implementación y manejo sin tener que gestionar directamente los clusters o pods. Es la solución ideal para gestionar pipelines de ML en Google Cloud.

- **:red[Cloud Composer]**: Aunque utiliza Kubernetes en algún nivel, está más orientado a la orquestación de flujos de trabajo basados en Apache Airflow, y no está optimizado específicamente para pipelines de machine learning.

- **:red[Cloud Orchestrator]**: No es un producto específico de Google Cloud relacionado directamente con Kubernetes para pipelines, por lo que no es aplicable en este caso.

- **:red[Kubeflow]**: Aunque facilita el despliegue de flujos de trabajo de machine learning en Kubernetes, no está diseñado específicamente para gestionar pipelines detrás de escenas como lo hace Vertex Pipelines. Kubeflow es una plataforma más amplia para gestionar experimentos de ML, pero no proporciona la simplicidad y automatización de pipelines como Vertex Pipelines.

question: AI Hub has templates for which of the following?
answers: Trained models
All other answers are correct
Jupyter notebooks
Kubeflow pipelines and components
correct_answer: All other answers are correct
explanation:
- **:green[✅All other answers are correct]**: AI Hub proporciona una variedad de recursos, incluyendo **modelos entrenados**, **notebooks de Jupyter**, y **componentes y pipelines de Kubeflow**, todos disponibles como plantillas para facilitar el desarrollo de soluciones de IA. Esta opción es correcta ya que resume todas las funcionalidades ofrecidas por AI Hub.

- **:red[Trained models]**: AI Hub ofrece plantillas para modelos entrenados que los usuarios pueden emplear para acelerar el desarrollo de sus aplicaciones de IA.

- **:red[Jupyter notebooks]**: Disponibles para proporcionar ejemplos y tutoriales interactivos que ayudan a los usuarios a aprender y desarrollar rápidamente soluciones de machine learning.

- **:red[Kubeflow pipelines and components]**: Incluidos para ayudar a los usuarios a construir y desplegar flujos de trabajo de machine learning escalables, proporcionando herramientas para la automatización y la orquestación de procesos de ML.

question: BigQuery ML has support for which of the following modeling tasks:
answers: Classification
Computer vision
Clustering
Regression
correct_answer: Classification
Clustering
Regression
explanation:
- **✅:green[Classification]**: BigQuery ML soporta tareas de clasificación, permitiendo a los usuarios crear y ejecutar modelos de clasificación directamente en BigQuery.
- **:red[Computer vision]**: Esto es incorrecto; BigQuery ML no está diseñado para tareas de visión computarizada, ya que se centra más en datos estructurados.
- **✅:green[Clustering]**: Soporta clustering, permitiendo a los usuarios agrupar datos similares dentro de BigQuery utilizando modelos como k-means.
- **✅:green[Regression]**: También soporta regresión, facilitando la construcción de modelos predictivos para estimar valores continuos.

question: True or False? You can train and evaluate machine learning models directly in BigQuery.
answers: True
False
correct_answer: True
explanation: - **✅:green[True]**: Puedes entrenar y evaluar modelos de machine learning directamente dentro de BigQuery sin necesidad de mover tus datos a otra plataforma, lo que simplifica el proceso y reduce la latencia en obtener insights.

question: Which of the following are valid techniques for improving AutoML Vision and AutoML Natural Language models?
answers: Ensure consistent labeling
Increase the diversity and complexity of data
Increase the number of labels
Increase the amount of training data
correct_answer: Ensure consistent labeling
Increase the diversity and complexity of data
Increase the amount of training data
explanation:
- **✅:green[Ensure consistent labeling]**: Asegurar etiquetado consistente es crucial para mejorar el rendimiento de los modelos de AutoML, ya que reduce la ambigüedad y mejora la precisión del aprendizaje.
- **✅:green[Increase the diversity and complexity of data]**: Incrementar la diversidad y complejidad de los datos ayuda a los modelos a generalizar mejor sobre nuevos ejemplos y situaciones no vistas durante el entrenamiento.
- **:red[Increase the number of labels]**: Aumentar el número de etiquetas no necesariamente mejora el modelo y puede complicar el aprendizaje si no se maneja correctamente.
- **✅:green[Increase the amount of training data]**: Más datos de entrenamiento pueden proporcionar más ejemplos para aprender, mejorando la capacidad del modelo para identificar patrones y reducir el sobreajuste.

question: AutoML makes use of which of the following:
answers: Your models and your data
Google's models and Google's data
Your models and Google's data
Google's models and your data
correct_answer: Google's models and your data
explanation:
- **✅:green[Google's models and your data]**: **AutoML** utiliza modelos desarrollados por Google y los aplica a tus propios datos para crear modelos personalizados que se ajustan específicamente a tus necesidades y casos de uso. Este es el enfoque de **AutoML**, donde Google proporciona los algoritmos y las herramientas de aprendizaje automático, mientras que tú proporcionas los datos para entrenar estos modelos según los requisitos específicos de tu proyecto.

- **:red[Your models and your data]**: Esto se aplica a la **AI Platform** personalizada, donde puedes usar tus propios modelos y datos, pero no es el caso de **AutoML**.

- **:red[Google's models and Google's data]**: Google no utiliza sus propios datos en **AutoML**; aunque usa modelos preentrenados por Google, se requiere que los usuarios aporten sus propios datos para un entrenamiento personalizado.

- **:red[Your models and Google's data]**: No es típico que Google ofrezca sus datos para ser usados con los modelos personalizados del usuario en **AutoML**. Los usuarios aportan los datos para entrenar los modelos desarrollados por Google.

question: You are working on optimizing BigQuery for a query that is run repeatedly on a single table. The data queried is about 1 GB, and some rows are expected to change about 10 times every hour. You have optimized the SQL statements as much as possible. You want to further optimize the query's performance. What should you do?
answers: Create a materialized view based on the table, and query that view.
Enable caching of the queried data so that subsequent queries are faster.
Create a scheduled query, and run it a few minutes before the report has to be created.
Reserve a larger number of slots in advance so that you have maximum compute power to execute the query.
correct_answer: Create a materialized view based on the table, and query that view.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Create a materialized view based on the table]**: Las vistas materializadas cachean los resultados de una consulta de manera periódica, lo que aumenta el rendimiento de las consultas repetidas. Además, están optimizadas para conjuntos de datos pequeños que cambian con frecuencia.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las demás opciones no proporcionan mejoras de rendimiento significativas, ya que la caché se invalida cuando los datos subyacentes cambian, las consultas programadas no mejoran el rendimiento, y reservar más slots no optimiza la ejecución en términos de velocidad.

question: Several years ago, you built a machine learning model for an ecommerce company. Your model made good predictions. Then a global pandemic occurred, lockdowns were imposed, and many people started working from home. Now the quality of your model has degraded. You want to improve the quality of your model and prevent future performance degradation. What should you do?
answers: Retrain the model with data from the first 30 days of the lockdown.
Monitor data until usage patterns normalize, and then retrain the model.
Retrain the model with data from the last 30 days. After one year, return to the older model.
Retrain the model with data from the last 30 days. Add a step to continuously monitor model input data for changes, and retrain the model.
correct_answer: Retrain the model with data from the last 30 days. Add a step to continuously monitor model input data for changes, and retrain the model.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Retrain the model with data from the last 30 days. Add a step to continuously monitor model input data for changes]**: Esta opción es correcta porque la situación actual ha cambiado y los patrones de uso previos ya no son relevantes. Al entrenar con datos recientes y monitorear continuamente el flujo de datos para futuros cambios, se asegura la relevancia continua del modelo.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las otras opciones no abordan el problema a largo plazo. Entrenar con datos antiguos o simplemente monitorear sin ajustar el modelo no solucionará el problema de degradación del rendimiento.

question: A new member of your development team works remotely. The developer will write code locally on their laptop, which will connect to a MySQL instance on Cloud SQL. The instance has an external (public) IP address. You want to follow Google-recommended practices when you give access to Cloud SQL to the new team member. What should you do?
answers: Ask the developer for their laptop's IP address, and add it to the authorized networks list.
Remove the external IP address, and replace it with an internal IP address. Add only the IP address for the remote developer's laptop to the authorized list.
Give instance access permissions in Identity and Access Management (IAM), and have the developer run Cloud SQL Auth proxy to connect to a MySQL instance.
Give instance access permissions in Identity and Access Management (IAM), change the access to 'private service access' for security, and allow the developer to access Cloud SQL from their laptop.
correct_answer: Give instance access permissions in Identity and Access Management (IAM), and have the developer run Cloud SQL Auth proxy to connect to a MySQL instance.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Give instance access permissions in Identity and Access Management (IAM), and have the developer run Cloud SQL Auth proxy]**: Usar el proxy de autenticación de Cloud SQL es la forma recomendada por Google para manejar el acceso remoto a instancias de bases de datos en la nube, porque asegura una conexión segura y evita la necesidad de gestionar direcciones IP de redes autorizadas manualmente.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las otras opciones no siguen las mejores prácticas, como usar listas de redes autorizadas, que es menos seguro y más difícil de gestionar, o cambiar a acceso privado, que complicaría la conectividad para desarrolladores remotos.

question: Your Cloud Spanner database stores customer address information that is frequently accessed by the marketing team. When a customer enters the country and the state where they live, this information is stored in different tables connected by a foreign key. The current architecture has performance issues. You want to follow Google-recommended practices to improve performance. What should you do?
answers: Create interleaved tables, and store states under the countries.
Denormalize the data, and have a row for each state with its corresponding country.
Retain the existing architecture, but use short, two-letter codes for the countries and states.
Combine the countries in a single cell's text, for example 'country:state1,state2,…' and when required, split the data.
correct_answer: Create interleaved tables, and store states under the countries.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Create interleaved tables, and store states under the countries]**: Cloud Spanner soporta tablas entrelazadas, lo que garantiza que los datos relacionados se almacenen juntos, optimizando el rendimiento cuando se necesita un fuerte enfoque en la relación de localización de los datos.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las demás opciones no abordan los problemas de rendimiento tan eficientemente. La desnormalización aumenta la duplicación de datos, y usar códigos más cortos o combinar datos en una única celda no optimiza el acceso ni las consultas.

question: Your company runs its business-critical system on PostgreSQL. The system is accessed simultaneously from many locations around the world and supports millions of customers. Your database administration team manages the redundancy and scaling manually. You want to migrate the database to Google Cloud. You need a solution that will provide global scale and availability and require minimal maintenance. What should you do?
answers: Migrate to BigQuery.
Migrate to Cloud Spanner.
Migrate to a Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL instance.
Migrate to bare metal machines with PostgreSQL installed.
correct_answer: Migrate to Cloud Spanner.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Migrate to Cloud Spanner]**: Cloud Spanner es la mejor opción para bases de datos relacionales con escala global y alta disponibilidad, con mínima administración. Ofrece consistencia fuerte y escalabilidad horizontal automática.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: BigQuery no es adecuado para bases de datos transaccionales, Cloud SQL es regional y no soporta la escala global, y los servidores bare metal requieren mucho mantenimiento manual.

question: Your company collects data about customers to regularly check their health vitals. You have millions of customers around the world. Data is ingested at an average rate of two events per 10 seconds per user. You need to be able to visualize data in Bigtable on a per user basis. You need to construct the Bigtable key so that the operations are performant. What should you do?
answers: Construct the key as user-id#device-id#activity-id#timestamp.
Construct the key as timestamp#user-id#device-id#activity-id.
Construct the key as timestamp#device-id#activity-id#user-id.
Construct the key as user-id#timestamp#device-id#activity-id.
correct_answer: Construct the key as user-id#device-id#activity-id#timestamp.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Construct the key as user-id#device-id#activity-id#timestamp]**: Este diseño evita el aumento monotónico en los identificadores, que puede generar hotspots en Bigtable. El orden de la clave permite un acceso eficiente por usuario.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las demás opciones tienen claves que aumentan monotonamente (comenzando con timestamp), lo que genera hotspots y disminuye el rendimiento en bases de datos distribuidas como Bigtable.

question: Your company is hiring several business analysts who are new to BigQuery. The analysts will use BigQuery to analyze large quantities of data. You need to control costs in BigQuery and ensure that there is no budget overrun while you maintain the quality of query results. What should you do?
answers: Set a customized project-level or user-level daily quota to acceptable values.
Reduce the data in the BigQuery table so that the analysts query less data, and then archive the remaining data.
Train the analysts to use the query validator or --dry_run to estimate costs so that the analysts can self-regulate usage.
Export the BigQuery daily costs, and visualize the data on Looker on a per-analyst basis so that the analysts can self-regulate usage.
correct_answer: Set a customized project-level or user-level daily quota to acceptable values.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Set a customized project-level or user-level daily quota]**: Establecer cuotas diarias permite controlar los costos al limitar la cantidad de datos procesados por día en BigQuery, garantizando así que no se exceda el presupuesto.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las otras opciones suponen que los analistas pueden regular su propio uso o disminuyen la calidad de los resultados al reducir los datos disponibles.

question: Your Bigtable database was recently deployed into production. The scale of data ingested and analyzed has increased significantly, but the performance has degraded. You want to identify the performance issue. What should you do?
answers: Use Key Visualizer to analyze performance.
Use Cloud Trace to identify the performance issue.
Add logging statements into the code to see which inserts cause the delay.
Add more nodes to the cluster to see if that resolves the performance issue.
correct_answer: Use Key Visualizer to analyze performance.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Use Key Visualizer to analyze performance]**: Key Visualizer es una herramienta diseñada específicamente para Bigtable que proporciona informes visuales detallados sobre el uso y los patrones de acceso a las claves, lo que facilita la identificación de problemas de rendimiento.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las demás opciones no son adecuadas para identificar problemas específicos de rendimiento en Bigtable, como la sobrecarga de nodos o el diseño ineficiente de claves.

question: Your company is moving your data analytics to BigQuery. Your other operations will remain on-premises. You need to transfer 800 TB of historic data. You also need to plan for 30 Gbps of daily data transfers that must be appended for analysis the next day. You want to follow Google-recommended practices to transfer your data. What should you do?
answers: As early as possible every day, use Cloud VPN to transfer the existing data over the internet.
Use a Transfer Appliance to move the existing data to Google Cloud. Use Cloud VPN to transfer data daily.
Use a Transfer Appliance to move the existing data to Google Cloud. Use VPC Network Peering to transfer data daily.
Use a Transfer Appliance to move the existing data to Google Cloud. Set up a Dedicated or Partner Interconnect for daily transfers.
correct_answer: Use a Transfer Appliance to move the existing data to Google Cloud. Set up a Dedicated or Partner Interconnect for daily transfers.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Use a Transfer Appliance and set up a Dedicated or Partner Interconnect]**: Transfer Appliance es la solución recomendada para mover grandes cantidades de datos históricos, y para transferencias diarias de gran volumen, se recomienda una conexión dedicada o híbrida para garantizar alta velocidad y estabilidad.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las demás opciones, como Cloud VPN, no son adecuadas para manejar transferencias de datos a gran escala o requieren soluciones que no son recomendadas para transferencias constantes de gran volumen.

question: Your team runs Dataproc workloads where the worker node takes about 45 minutes to process. You have been exploring various options to optimize the system for cost, including shutting down worker nodes aggressively. However, in your metrics you see that the entire job takes even longer. You want to optimize the system for cost without increasing job completion time. What should you do?
answers: Set a graceful decommissioning timeout greater than 45 minutes.
Rewrite the processing in Cloud Data Fusion, and run the job automatically.
Rewrite the processing in Dataflow, and use stream processing of the same data.
Increase the number of vCPUs on each worker node so that the processing finishes sooner.
correct_answer: Set a graceful decommissioning timeout greater than 45 minutes.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Set a graceful decommissioning timeout greater than 45 minutes]**: Al establecer un tiempo de espera para el apagado gradual mayor a 45 minutos, se permite que los nodos completen el trabajo en curso antes de ser desactivados, lo que optimiza los costos sin aumentar el tiempo total de ejecución.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Reescribir en Data Fusion o Dataflow implica costos adicionales y mayor esfuerzo, mientras que aumentar el número de vCPUs aumentaría significativamente los costos sin necesariamente mejorar la eficiencia general.

question: Your customer has a SQL Server database that contains about 5 TB of data in another public cloud. You expect the data to grow to a maximum of 25 TB. The database is the backend of an internal reporting application that is used once a week. You want to migrate the application to Google Cloud to reduce administrative effort while keeping costs the same or reducing them. What should you do?
answers: Migrate the database to Bigtable.
Migrate the database to Cloud Spanner.
Install SQL Server on a Compute Engine VM.
Migrate the database to SQL Server in Cloud SQL.
correct_answer: Migrate the database to SQL Server in Cloud SQL.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Migrate the database to SQL Server in Cloud SQL]**: Cloud SQL ofrece una solución gestionada para bases de datos SQL Server, lo que reduce el esfuerzo administrativo y permite escalar hasta 25 TB sin complicaciones adicionales.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Bigtable no es adecuado para bases de datos SQL, Cloud Spanner es más costoso y no necesario para esta aplicación, y ejecutar SQL Server en Compute Engine requiere más esfuerzo administrativo.

question: Your IT team uses BigQuery for storing structured data. Your finance team recently moved to Google Workspace Enterprise edition from a standalone, desktop-based spreadsheet processor. When the finance team needs data insights, the IT team runs a query on BigQuery, exports the data to a CSV file, and sends the file as an email attachment to the finance team members. You want to improve the process while you retain familiar methods of data analysis for the finance team. What should you do?
answers: Run the query in BigQuery, and give the finance team access to the results view, which can be analyzed.
Run the query in BigQuery, and give the finance team access to the data visualizations in Google Data Studio.
Run the query in BigQuery, export the data to CSV, upload the file to a Cloud Storage bucket, and share the file with the finance team.
Run the query in BigQuery, and save the results to a Google Sheets shared spreadsheet that can be accessed and analyzed by the finance team.
correct_answer: Run the query in BigQuery, and save the results to a Google Sheets shared spreadsheet that can be accessed and analyzed by the finance team.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Run the query in BigQuery, and save the results to a Google Sheets shared spreadsheet]**: Connected Sheets permite compartir datos directamente desde BigQuery a Google Sheets, lo que permite que el equipo de finanzas continúe usando una herramienta familiar para el análisis de datos.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las demás opciones no aprovechan al máximo el ecosistema de Google Workspace o requerirían capacitación adicional y acceso a herramientas más complejas como BigQuery o Cloud Storage.

question: Your scooter-sharing company collects information about their scooters, such as location, battery level, and speed. The company visualizes this data in real time. To guard against intermittent connectivity, each scooter sends repeats of certain messages within a short interval. Occasional data errors have been noticed. The messages are received in Pub/Sub and stored in BigQuery. You need to ensure that the data does not contain duplicates and that erroneous data with empty fields is rejected. What should you do?
answers: Store the data in BigQuery, and run delete queries on erroneous and duplicate data.
Use Dataflow to subscribe to Pub/Sub, process the data, and store the data in BigQuery.
Use Kubernetes to create a microservices application that can remove duplicates and erroneous data. Then insert the data into BigQuery.
Create an application on Compute Engine with Managed Instance Groups that can remove duplicates and erroneous data. Then insert the data into BigQuery.
correct_answer: Use Dataflow to subscribe to Pub/Sub, process the data, and store the data in BigQuery.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Use Dataflow to subscribe to Pub/Sub, process the data, and store the data in BigQuery]**: Dataflow es la opción recomendada para procesar datos en streaming, ya que puede eliminar duplicados, manejar campos vacíos y procesar datos de manera eficiente antes de almacenarlos en BigQuery.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las otras opciones implican más esfuerzo de desarrollo o no garantizan la limpieza de los datos antes de almacenarlos en BigQuery.

question: Your cryptocurrency trading company visualizes prices to help your customers make trading decisions. Because different trades happen in real time, the price data is fed to a data pipeline that uses Dataflow for processing. You want to compute moving averages. What should you do?
answers: Use hopping windows in Dataflow.
Use session windows in Dataflow.
Use tumbling windows in Dataflow.
Use Dataflow SQL, and compute averages grouped by time.
correct_answer: Use hopping windows in Dataflow.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Use hopping windows in Dataflow]**: Las ventanas deslizantes (hopping windows) son ideales para calcular promedios móviles, ya que pueden superponerse y representar intervalos de tiempo consistentes en un flujo de datos.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Las demás opciones, como las ventanas de sesión o ventanas disjuntas (tumbling), no son apropiadas para promedios móviles.

question: You are building the trading platform for a stock exchange with millions of traders. Trading data is written rapidly. You need to retrieve data quickly to show visualizations to the traders, such as the changing price of a particular stock over time. You need to choose a storage solution in Google Cloud. What should you do?
answers: Use Bigtable.
Use Firestore.
Use Cloud SQL.
Use Memorystore.
correct_answer: Use Bigtable.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Use Bigtable]**: Bigtable es la solución recomendada para almacenar y recuperar datos de series temporales con un alto rendimiento de lectura y escritura. Es ideal para almacenar grandes volúmenes de datos rápidamente cambiantes.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Firestore, Cloud SQL y Memorystore no tienen las capacidades de alto rendimiento necesarias para manejar este tipo de datos de series temporales.

question: Your customer uses Hadoop and Spark to run data analytics on-premises. The main data is stored in hard disks that are centrally accessed. Your customer needs to migrate their workloads to Google Cloud efficiently while considering scalability. You want to select an architecture that requires minimal effort. What should you do?
answers: Use Dataproc to run Hadoop and Spark jobs. Move the data to Cloud Storage.
Use Dataflow to recreate the jobs in a serverless approach. Move the data to Cloud Storage.
Use Dataproc to run Hadoop and Spark jobs. Retain the data on a Compute Engine VM with an attached persistent disk.
Use Dataflow to recreate the jobs in a serverless approach. Retain the data on a Compute Engine VM with an attached persistent disk.
correct_answer: Use Dataproc to run Hadoop and Spark jobs. Move the data to Cloud Storage.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Use Dataproc to run Hadoop and Spark jobs. Move the data to Cloud Storage]**: Dataproc es un servicio gestionado que permite ejecutar trabajos de Hadoop y Spark de manera eficiente en Google Cloud. Almacenar los datos en Cloud Storage es la mejor práctica recomendada para el almacenamiento persistente.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Reescribir los trabajos en Dataflow requiere mucho esfuerzo, y mantener los datos en discos persistentes no es la mejor práctica para escalabilidad.

question: You used a small amount of data to build a machine learning model that gives you good inferences during testing. However, the results show more errors when real-world data is used to run the model. No additional data can be collected for testing. You want to get a more accurate view of the model's capability. What should you do?
answers: Reduce the amount of data to improve the model.
Cross-validate the data, and re-run the model building process.
Create feature crosses that will add new columns to increase the data.
Duplicate the data twice to increase the data, and re-run the model building process.
correct_answer: Cross-validate the data, and re-run the model building process.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Cross-validate the data, and re-run the model building process]**: La validación cruzada es una técnica recomendada cuando un modelo parece estar sobreajustado. Al hacer validación cruzada, se reduce el sobreajuste del modelo al dividir el conjunto de datos en múltiples particiones o 'folds'.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Reducir o duplicar los datos no abordará el problema del sobreajuste, y agregar columnas no mejorará la validación del modelo con los datos existentes.

question: Your organization has been collecting information for many years about your customers, including their address and credit card details. You plan to use this customer data to build machine learning models on Google Cloud. You are concerned about private data leaking into the machine learning model. Your management is also concerned that direct leaks of personal data could damage the company's reputation. You need to address these concerns about data security. What should you do?
answers: Remove all the tables that contain sensitive data.
Use libraries like SciPy to build the ML models on your local computer.
Remove the sensitive data by using the Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP) API.
Identify the rows that contain sensitive data, and apply SQL queries to remove only those rows.
correct_answer: Remove the sensitive data by using the Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP) API.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Remove the sensitive data by using the Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP) API]**: Cloud DLP es la herramienta recomendada para redacción, enmascaramiento y tokenización de datos sensibles. Esto asegura que el modelo no tenga acceso a información personal identificable o confidencial.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Eliminar datos completos o realizar operaciones localmente no es eficiente ni garantiza la seguridad de los datos a escala, mientras que eliminar filas completas afectaría la precisión del modelo.

question: Your healthcare application has a backend system that accepts event data directly from IoT devices. Recent increases of the application's users and devices are causing a sudden influx of data that overwhelms the system. You need to redesign the data pipeline to ensure that all data is processed and that no events are lost. You want to follow Google-recommended practices. What should you do?
answers: Use Kafka with pull mode.
Use Pub/Sub with pull mode.
Use Pub/Sub with push mode.
Run Cloud Scheduler at fixed intervals.
correct_answer: Use Pub/Sub with pull mode.
explanation:
- **✅:green[Use Pub/Sub with pull mode]**: Pub/Sub es la solución gestionada recomendada por Google para procesar grandes volúmenes de eventos de manera eficiente. Usar el modo pull permite que el sistema controle cuándo procesar nuevos eventos según la capacidad disponible, evitando sobrecargas.
- **:red[Rest of the options]**: Usar Kafka o el modo push puede no ser adecuado para este escenario gestionado, y ejecutar Cloud Scheduler a intervalos fijos no garantiza que todos los eventos se procesen a tiempo.
